title: Universal Diffusion Models for Implied Volatility Surfaces: Learning Shared Dynamics Across Stocks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22893v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling the dynamics of option implied volatility surface (IVS) is crucial for pricing, hedging, and risk-managing option portfolios. We develop a universal conditional diffusion model that learns to jointly generate next-day IVS increments and the underlying stock's returns. The model is trained on pooled data from 50 stocks and evaluated on a test set comprising 50 in-sample stocks and 50 out-of-sample stocks excluded from training. The training objective is primarily the minimization of MSE, with the variants that jointly impose surface smoothness, and that penalize the presence of static-arbitrage, which are all economically meaningful constraints. Across in-sample and out-of-sample stocks, our diffusion model outperforms the VolGAN benchmark in reducing arbitrage violations, improving stock risk prediction, and aligning explained variance ratios by the first three principal components. translated_title: 隐含波动率曲面的通用扩散模型：学习跨股票的共享动态
translated_abstract: 对期权隐含波动率曲面（IVS）的动态进行建模，对于期权组合的定价、对冲和风险管理至关重要。我们开发了一个通用的条件扩散模型，学习联合生成次日的IVS增量以及标的股票的收益率。该模型在50只股票的汇总数据上进行训练，并在由50只样本内股票和50只未参与训练的样本外股票组成的测试集上进行评估。训练目标主要是最小化均方误差（MSE），同时提供了若干变体：联合施加曲面平滑性约束以及惩罚静态套利的存在，这些都是具有经济学意义的约束条件。在样本内和样本外股票上，我们的扩散模型在减少套利违反、改进股票风险预测，以及使前三个主成分解释的方差比率对齐方面均优于VolGAN基准。该模型能够很好地外推至……
tldr: 本文提出一个通用条件扩散模型，通过联合生成次日隐含波动率曲面增量与股票收益，在样本内外股票上均优于VolGAN基准，有效减少套利违反并改进风险预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a universal conditional diffusion model that jointly generates next-day implied volatility surface increments and stock returns, outperforming the VolGAN benchmark on both in-sample and out-of-sample stocks by reducing arbitrage violations and improving risk prediction.
